name: DeenOne Bangla Quran Official All-in-One API
description: Ultra-fast, globally edge-cached static REST API for the Holy Quran with Arabic text, Bangla translation, Dual Audio streams (Arabic & Bangla BT), and Bangla Tafsir.

endpoints.name: All Surahs List (Dual Audio)
endpoints.description: Returns the complete list of 114 Surahs with metadata and both Arabic and Bangla audio links.

endpoints.name: All-in-One Surah (Arabic, Bangla, Arabic Audio, Bangla Audio, Tafsir)
endpoints.description: Returns all ayahs for the requested surah with Arabic text, Bengali translation, Arabic audio URL (audioArabic), Bangla audio URL (audioBangla), and embedded Bengali Tafsir for every ayah.

endpoints.name: Complete Quran All-in-One (All 114 Surahs)
endpoints.description: The entire Holy Quran in a single JSON payload with all 114 surahs, ayahs, Arabic, Bangla, dual audio URLs, and tafsir.

endpoints.name: Surah Bangla Tafsir Only
endpoints.description: Returns Bengali Tafsir (Abu Bakr Zakaria) mapped by ayah number.
